Third-party model attributions - additions for the Mikdash Courtyard walkthrough credits
========================================================================================

Prepared 2026-09-07 for Scripts/release_import_thirdparty_vessels.py. Copy these lines into the
distributed credits (in-game credits screen, README of every build, and any page or video that shows
the models). The wording follows each folder's LICENSE.txt. Only the two models below are imported;
the GPL-3.0 folders (aron-ark-pazzah-mishkan-printables-GPL, menorah-pazzah-mishkan-printables-GPL)
are NOT used and need no attribution.

1. Aron (body with poles, and lid with keruvim) - imported as
   /Game/MikdashV3/ThirdParty/Vessels/Meshes/SM_ThirdParty_AronBody_davidgra11 and
   /Game/MikdashV3/ThirdParty/Vessels/Meshes/SM_ThirdParty_AronLid_davidgra11

   "Ark of the Covenant Box" by davidgra11 (Thingiverse user; same design on Printables as
   "David graubart 11"), https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:7391849, licensed Creative Commons
   Attribution-ShareAlike (Thingiverse license code "cc-sa"; version not stated in the zip -
   Thingiverse currently links CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
   Changes: converted from the original 3MF to two OBJ meshes (per-face normals, welded vertices,
   each re-based with XY centred and bottom at Z 0), imported into Unreal Engine, scaled x1.471 to a
   125 cm long body, given a flat gold material, and placed in the Kodesh of the walkthrough.

   ShareAlike notice: because this model is CC BY-SA, every derivative of it stays CC BY-SA - the
   imported .uasset files, the two OBJ conversions in this folder, any screenshot, video frame or
   build in which the Aron model is the featured content, and any further remix. Such derivatives
   must carry this attribution and the same license (or a compatible later CC BY-SA version), and
   may not be re-licensed under a more restrictive or a non-ShareAlike license. Note kept with the
   asset: the same author lists this model on Printables (model 1800658) as CC BY-NC; the copy used
   here is the Thingiverse copy carrying CC BY-SA (provenance.json in the asset folder).

2. Menorah - imported as /Game/MikdashV3/ThirdParty/Vessels/Meshes/SM_ThirdParty_Menorah_DahanMeir

   "The Menorah in the Temple in Jerusalem - based on the structure from the Arch of Triumph
   (Titus) in Rome" by Dahan Meir (Printables user),
   https://www.printables.com/model/1501834-the-menorah-in-the-temple-in-jerusalem-based-on-th,
   licensed Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
   (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
   Changes: converted from the original STL to OBJ (per-face normals, welded vertices, units
   unchanged), imported into Unreal Engine, scaled x0.715 to 150 cm tall including the base, given a
   flat gold material, and placed in the Heikhal of the walkthrough.

   CC BY 4.0 requires this attribution, the license link and an indication of changes on every
   distribution; it does not restrict the license of the surrounding work.

Both attributions must remain in SourceAssets/third-party/<slug>/LICENSE.txt and provenance.json
next to the source files; this file only collects the lines to add to the distributed credits.
